title: Spouse-Protected Tontines: Household Decumulation via Neural-Network Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.39569v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a spouse-protected tontine in which a first death changes the household state but generates no pool transfer. The same account remains attached to the household contract until extinction and funds a spouse-only continuation phase if the retiree dies first. We derive contract-level actuarial-fairness conditions and a finite-pool mortality-credit allocation rule with exact ex post budget balance. Under a homogeneous large-pool approximation, we formulate a multidimensional decumulation problem for a representative household, with withdrawal and rebalancing controls while the retiree is alive. The objective balances expected cumulative real household payments against the Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) of terminal shortfalls relative to household reserve targets, without conditioning on survival to the horizon. translated_title: 配偶保障型唐提年金：基于神经网络优化的家庭退休资产提取
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一种配偶保障型唐提年金，在该设计中，配偶一方先去世只会改变家庭状态，而不会引发资金池转移。同一账户始终与家庭合约绑定直至合约终止；若退休者先去世，该账户将为仅限配偶的延续阶段提供资金。我们推导了合约层面的精算公平性条件，以及一种有限资金池下具有精确事后预算平衡的死亡率信用分配规则。在同质大资金池近似下，我们为代表性家庭构建了一个多维的资产提取问题，包含退休者在世期间的资金提取与再平衡控制。该目标函数在家庭预期累计实际支付与相对于家庭储备目标的期末缺口条件风险价值（CVaR）之间进行权衡，且不以家庭生存至期限末为条件。我们基于对策略的全局时间神经网络参数化，为该问题开发了一种数值求解方法。
tldr: 本文提出一种配偶保障型唐提年金：配偶一方先去世时不产生资金池转移，而是触发仅限配偶的延续阶段，并通过神经网络优化求解家庭资产提取问题，在预期累计支付与期末缺口CVaR风险之间取得平衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a spouse-protected tontine in which the first death generates no pool transfer but funds a spouse-only continuation phase, and solves the household decumulation problem via global-in-time neural-network optimization balancing expected payments against the CVaR of terminal shortfalls.
